items.information: Bali Mini Speedcubing 2026 is a one-day mini speedcubing competition featuring a limited selection of official events. Pendaftaran tidak akan diproses apabila peserta belum mengisi formulir konfirmasi yang dapat diakses di [sini](https://forms.gle/pbGQ1wcsHmQh6a7g9) . items.name: Itaipu Open 2026

venue.name: Central Festas Itaipu
venue.address: Avenida Ewerton da Costa Xavier, 2496, Niterói, 24340-105, RJ, BR

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTUxNzQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--17016ac1ed61251cf2a6d4d6760c727b6f917f7b/25%20mesas%20100%20cadeiras.png) Dicas: - Chegue ao local da competição pelo menos 30 minutos antes de modalidade que participará; - O cubo que você irá competir deve estar em bom estado; - Você é responsável pelo seu cubo e seus pertences, cuide deles. Não nos responsabilizamos por perda de cubos mágicos e outros pertences durante a competição; - Se tiver alguma dúvida, não hesite em perguntar para a equipe de organização e delegados. - Ao se inscrever você está autorizando o uso de imagem para divulgações sobre o campeonato. - Só serão aceitas inscrições no local para a modalidade 3x3. Mesmo que a nossa competição seja formada por alguns competidores experientes, sempre teremos espaço para novos cubistas. Procure se divertir bastante! Tips: - Arrive at the competition venue at least 30 minutes before the event you will be participating in; - The cube you will be competing with must be in good condition; - You are responsible for your cube and your belongings, so take care of them. We are not responsible for the loss of magic cubes and other belongings during the competition; - If you have any questions, don't hesitate to ask the organizing team and delegates. - By registering, you are authorizing the use of your image for publicity about the competition. - Only on-site registrations will be accepted for the 3x3 event. Even though our competition is made up of some experienced competitors, we always have room for new cubers. Have fun!

items.name: NCSU Wolfpack Spring 2026

venue.name: North Carolina State University Talley Student Union
venue.details: Piedmont + Mountains Ballroom on the third level (one floor up from main level entrances)

items.information: **All competitors must read the [Competitor Information tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NCSUWolfpackSpring2026#69863-competitor-information) prior to registering.** Please read all tabs prior to the competition and regularly check your email for updates from us. All contact will be made by email. This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about), the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast! Please check out the [Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/NCSUWolfpackSpring2026#69868-southeast-cubing-inc) to learn more about the organization and what you can do to support the mission. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png) Additionally, this competition has been made possible with the help of CubePack, the cubing club at NC State! All NC State students who are official members of CubePack on Get Involved will receive refunded registration. You must pay up front and will be refunded after the competition.
